# PR #153 round-4 correctness review

## A. Verdict

**PASS-WITH-NOTES** at `7b7fc1388b4de424776a0ce2aa61ab5834e72770`.

**F004 closed.** Earlier F001-F003 closures stand. No further correctness repair requested for the scoped cancellation schedule.

## B. Scope

Only `fcfca246416d1afe02fae88cd72f866522d3d58b..7b7fc13`: owned registration/guard composition and its blocked-write regression. The accepted C32 identity residual and independent security/performance grades remain separately owned.

Clean pinned detached checkout; GitHub and ls-remote agree, PR CLEAN. CI run `42387081956`, attempt 2, succeeded at this full head. No local builds/tests, mutation runs, SQLite triggers or live probes were performed.

## C. Guard lifetime

ReportedContext's mutex is now shared by Arc. Exclusively acquires an owned mutex guard and moves it into the spawned task with work; dropping the waiter cannot drop that guard or continuation after admission.

The production handler puts register_via and grant selection/rotation in that same owned work. Thus a pending registry commit cannot continue after releasing the context section, and reports cannot reread the old row during a detached replacement write. The short synchronous grant-map lock is not held over an await. No ordinary reverse lock order was introduced.

## D. Distinguishing regression

`a_cancelled_registration_keeps_reports_out_until_its_write_commits` executed and passed. With another connection holding BEGIN IMMEDIATE, it starts the owned replacement/rotation work, cancels its waiter, and starts an already-authorized old report. The old report remains waiting; after the write lock releases it returns None, while the row has the replacement process/idle state, context remains unknown and generation is unchanged.

The same test includes the non-cancelled schedule. This is a real-store ownership/commit boundary control, not just a synthetic mutex acquisition test. It uses the same owned composition primitive; it is not a reviewer-run HTTP cancellation experiment.

## E. Retained safeguards

The mandatory audit withholding test, normal replaced-incarnation test, report-waits-for-registration case and F88 observable-size regression also executed. Reissue audit failure still withholds the token; first issuance remains separate. Moving grant rotation inside the owned work does not turn audit failure into a token return.

## F. CI

Downloaded JUnit contains 2,105 cases, zero failures/errors, including all five named controls. Latest Delivers succeeded, superseding an older cancelled run. The author-reported waiter-owned-guard mutation was not rerun here.

## G. Notes

The regression drives the shared ownership primitive and real registry put, while the full register_via lock/rotation wiring was source-reviewed. Runtime shutdown can still terminate tasks; this closure concerns cancellation of the requesting waiter while the runtime/store continue.

The Known limit still names PRD 003 req-10. C32's existing identity acceptance is unchanged; no stronger authentication is claimed. The daemon-wide mutex/extra native-registration task remains a performance qualification, not a new timer/process launch. Deployment readings and migration-order notes stand.

## H. Handover

F004 correctness closure is ready at this head. Retain independent security/performance verdicts and prior deployment obligations before whole-plan completion. The reviewer made no product changes.
